title: Ryan Coogler, Laura Poitras Address Renee Good Killing at National Board of Review Awards Gala
summary: In contrast to the Golden Globes, which featured few political comments from winners and presenters onstage, Tuesday night's New York ceremony saw speakers get political, with the 'Cover-Up' filmmaker talking about the "schizophrenic" nature of such ceremonies against the backdrop of tragic, contentious events in the U.S. and abroad.
